intent_summary: Analysis applies cooperative resource limits and exposes partial or failed results without discarding valid earlier or sibling evidence.

criteria.criterion: A method failure preserves evidence completed before the failure and reports the error.
Runtime budgets are checked cooperatively and produce an explicit stop reason.
CLI byte limits and execution failures produce distinct error exits.
A failed dataset or relationship leaves healthy sibling results available and marks the overall run partial.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected failure/budget and sibling-failure tests and error handlers: retained evidence through index 44, explicit runtime_budget, and healthy sibling results; budget checks are cooperative.
